# CANDIDATE: SOFTEN_FILTER_10_HTF_MODIFIER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Filter 10 currently requires strict HTF agreement (e.g., higher timeframe trend must align with entry direction) for an entry to proceed. This is too rigid and caused the engine to skip valid entries on near-miss days where HTF disagreed but the lower timeframe setup was strong. By converting the HTF requirement into a score modifier (subtract 1 from the setup score if HTF disagrees), we allow entries with strong lower timeframe signals to proceed even with mild HTF disagreement, capturing more true positives while still penalizing misalignment.

## Mechanism

Filter 10 is in `gates.py`. Instead of returning `False` when HTF disagrees, we will return `True` but subtract 1 from the `setup_score` variable (which is used later in the quality escalation logic). The HTF disagreement check remains, but its effect is reduced from a hard block to a soft penalty. No other changes to filter 10 logic.
